verdict.rationale: Consensus's Library feature lets users import their own PDFs, BibTeX, RIS, or Zotero collections and turns them into a searchable, AI-powered workspace where they can search and find gaps (consensus-docs-3, consensus-docs-13, consensus-docs-14, consensus-docs-9). However, the evidence doesn't clearly describe agentic Q&A/synthesis specifically over a user's uploaded corpus (most agent/synthesis claims reference Consensus's own 200M-paper corpus, not uploaded PDFs), and there's no independent corroboration of this workflow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the research agent reasoning/synthesizing directly over uploaded PDF content, and hands-on/independent verification of this workflow.
